summary.text: Matt Day is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Middle Tennessee native, outdoorsman, beekeeper and orchardist.

paragraphs.text: Matt Day listed his campaign messages in a Ballotpedia survey as making health care more available, protecting public schools and tax relief for working families.
He named health care availability, public education, tax fairness and economic equity as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
